name: HYDRA-UMC-VISION-STREAMER
notes: Established v0: real per-camera config validation, GStreamer pipeline description generation, and MediaMTX paths.yml generation, exposed via 'config validate'/'config gst'/'config mediamtx'. Real bounded frame buffering (drop-oldest backpressure, provably bounded memory under a slow consumer) and a real deterministic reconnect/backoff policy for a dropped camera link, exposed via 'stream simulate'. 45 tests. Actually running the generated pipeline against physical USB cameras needs the V4L2/GStreamer/Hailo-8 runtime, which is future work.
